name: kan-tools
description: Plugins from the kan-tools projects: a memory substrate and the process layer that sits on it.

plugins.name: kan
plugins.description: Local-first, provenance-preserving memory substrate for AI agents. Ships the kan MCP server; no commands or hooks of its own.

plugins.name: day
plugins.description: Structured process layer for AI-assisted development: teloi, composable process atoms, and drift assessment, all recorded in kan. Ships the design, adversarial-review, handoff, wakeup and witness-interview skills, plus SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit hooks.

plugins.name: cospan
plugins.description: Apex viewer for AI-driven development: one live TUI that folds many local agent sessions, files, and kan claims into a single view, over a drift-tracking comment layer on the code. Ships the cospan-comments MCP server (agents read and write the comment layer) and a bootstrap hook.
